Container.Name: CraftCommand-Center
Container.Overview: CraftCommand Center is a mobile-friendly companion dashboard for binhex-minecraftbedrockserver on Unraid. It discovers the active GNU screen session after restarts, discovers and saves player names, sends safe give/XP/kit commands, includes a version-tagged Bedrock item catalog, supports custom kits, role-based accounts, diagnostics, and persistent activity history.
Container.Requires: binhex-minecraftbedrockserver running on the same Unraid host. The Docker socket is required for companion control.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: CraftCommand Center WebUI host port.

Config.Name: Docker Socket
Config.Description: Required to discover and send commands to the Binhex Minecraft container.

Config.Name: Persistent Data
Config.Description: Stores manually added players, custom kits, extra dashboard accounts, and activity history.

Config.Name: Backup / Export Storage
Config.Description: Admin-created Bedrock server exports are stored here and can be downloaded from the Status tab.

Config.Name: Dashboard Title
Config.Description: Title shown in the WebUI.

Config.Name: Admin Username
Config.Description: Username for dashboard authentication.

Config.Name: Admin Password
Config.Description: Password for dashboard authentication. Change this before exposing the dashboard beyond your trusted LAN. HTTPS is still needed for encrypted transport.

Config.Name: Admin Password Hash
Config.Description: Optional scrypt hash generated with tools/hash-password.js. When set, it overrides Admin Password.

Config.Name: Minecraft Container Name
Config.Description: Exact Docker container name of the Binhex Minecraft Bedrock server.

Config.Name: Docker User
Config.Description: Linux user that owns the Binhex screen session.

Config.Name: Screen Session
Config.Description: Use auto to rediscover names such as 140.minecraft after restarts.

Config.Name: Command Method
Config.Description: attach is the compatible method for Binhex screen sessions that reject screen -X stuff.

Config.Name: Minecraft WebUI Console URL
Config.Description: Persistent quick link shown inside CraftCommand Center. [IP] resolves to the host used to open the app.

Config.Name: Unraid Docker URL
Config.Description: Persistent quick link shown inside CraftCommand Center.

Config.Name: External Reachability Check
Config.Description: Enable a Bedrock UDP ping against the public hostname/IP shown below.

Config.Name: External Minecraft Hostname / IP
Config.Description: Public DNS name or public IP used by players outside your home, for example minecraft.example.com. Do not include http://.

Config.Name: External Bedrock UDP Port
Config.Description: Public UDP port forwarded to the Bedrock server.

Config.Name: External Check Mode
Config.Description: external uses an internet-hosted Bedrock probe; local uses only Unraid/NAT loopback; both reports both results.

Config.Name: External Check Timeout (ms)
Config.Description: How long the Status tab waits for the public Bedrock UDP response.

Config.Name: Backup / Export Enabled
Config.Description: Allow admins to create and download a compressed export of the Binhex server data.

Config.Name: Binhex Backup Source Path
Config.Description: Path inside binhex-minecraftbedrockserver to export. The standard Binhex persistent data path is /config.

Config.Name: Backup Directory in App
Config.Description: Container-side destination. Keep this aligned with Backup / Export Storage.

Config.Name: Backup Retention
Config.Description: Number of newest server exports retained automatically.

Config.Name: Pause World Saves During Export
Config.Description: Send save hold before the archive and save resume afterward for a more consistent world export.

Config.Name: Session Hours
Config.Description: How long a successful dashboard login remains active.

Config.Name: Activity History
Config.Description: Record command and admin activity in persistent appdata.

Config.Name: Activity Retention
Config.Description: Approximate maximum activity entries retained after log rotation.
